sections.content_text: Section 53 - Limitation for Deduction of Interest (1) Notwithstanding anything contained in other provisions of this Act, subject to the provisions of sub-section (2), the procedure to be prescribed by the Board in respect of the approval of interest expenditure in any tax year by a resident person other than a bank and financial institution shall be allowed in relation to a subsidiary as defined in section 233, in any tax year shall be allowed in accordance with the procedures and limits prescribed by the Board. (2) Notwithstanding anything contained in sub-section (1), this section shall not apply if the amount of interest paid in any income year does not exceed Tk. 15 (fifteen) lakhs. Moreover, as per
